time_format.description: Format string for the stopwatch time display

digit_font.description: Font family name for the stopwatch digits

digit_font_size.description: Font size in points for the stopwatch digits

export_dir.description: Directory path where lap time export files are saved by default

default_export_format.description: Default file format for lap time exports (json or csv)
